name: qasper
question_type: information-seeking questions about one NLP research paper; meta.doc_id names the paper
answer_format: a concise answer: an extracted span or short phrase; 'Yes' / 'No' for yes-no questions; 'Unanswerable' if the paper does not answer it
metric_description: answer token F1 (SQuAD normalisation), max over the annotators' reference answers
meta: {"doc_id": <doc_id of the paper the question is about>}
